title: CLARKSONS HELLAS - SnP WEEKLY
summary:
Main
In the tanker space, geopolitical risk remains high after seven tankers were reportedly hit in Hormuz. Talk of lifting US sanctions is unlikely to offer much relief, since the 170 sanctioned VLCCs average 22 years of age and only 25 hold valid class certificates. On the freight side, VLCC spot earnings corrected by almost 25% this week to $541,000/day for eco-scrubber units.
